mapper.select: SELECT dept_id as id, parent_id as pid, dept_name as name, order_num as orderNum, dept_type as deptType FROM sys_dept WHERE del_flag = '0' AND dept_type = 'region' OR FIND_IN_SET( dept_id,( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( ancestors ) FROM sys_dept WHERE del_flag = '0' AND dept_type = 'region' GROUP BY dept_type ) )
